_help: Copy this file into your deck folder, rename it, and edit the cards list.
Set the folder in the widget's right-click menu under Decks, then reload.
Kotoba re-reads the folder on every shell start. TEMPLATE.json itself is
always skipped, so it is safe to leave a copy of it lying around.
id       required, unique, lowercase. Changing it makes a NEW deck and
your review history for the old one is kept under the old id.
name     required, what you see in the deck list.
license  free text. Anything that is not CC0-1.0 gets credited on the
tile, so put the real source here if the words came from one.
Each card needs kana and en. Everything else is optional:
jp      the written form. Leave it out and the word IS the kana, which
means no reading card is generated for it.
romaji  only as an override. It is derived from the kana automatically
and you do not need to write it unless the reading is irregular.
tags    free labels, for your own use.
freq    a number. Lower comes first when new cards are introduced.
meaning  always          reading  only when jp differs from kana
recall   always          kana     only for a single kana character
name: Words I met in the wild
